artist.name: FUSHI
artist.bio: FUSHI is a South Asian DJ who mixes bass music with leftfield club sounds, and has been part of the 4NC¥ collective since it started. FUSHI has played Bangalore, Goa, Kochi, Delhi, Chennai and Pondicherry, including Bangalore Massive and Dance OK Please, and has done mixes for Durian Radio, Subtle Radio, 8ball Radio and Wavlngth.
